tools.name: easypost_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments on the account, most recent first, with pagination and optional filters. API: GET /shipments.

tools.name: easypost_get_shipment
tools.description: Retrieve a single shipment by id, including its available rates, tracking_code, and postage_label (if purchased). API: GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_list_trackers
tools.description: List package trackers, optionally filtered by tracking_code or carrier. API: GET /trackers.

tools.name: easypost_get_tracker
tools.description: Retrieve a single tracker by id, including current status and tracking_details history. API: GET /trackers/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_list_addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses on the account, with pagination. API: GET /addresses.

tools.name: easypost_get_address
tools.description: Retrieve a single address by id, including verification details. API: GET /addresses/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_verify_address
tools.description: Create and verify a US or international address, returning deliverability and normalized/corrected fields. No charge. API: POST /addresses (body { address, verify: ["delivery"] }).

tools.name: easypost_create_shipment
tools.description: Create a shipment from a to_address, from_address, and parcel, returning the available RATES from all enabled carriers. This only RATES the shipment — it does NOT purchase a label and does NOT charge the account; buying is a separate step (easypost_buy_shipment). API: POST /shipments (body { shipmen

tools.name: easypost_create_tracker
tools.description: Start tracking a package by its carrier tracking code. Returns the tracker with current status. No charge. API: POST /trackers (body { tracker }).

tools.name: easypost_buy_shipment
tools.description: PURCHASE a shipping label for a shipment at a chosen rate. WARNING: this CHARGES the EasyPost account balance and is irreversible except by requesting a refund (easypost_refund_shipment). Pick a rate_id from the rates returned by easypost_create_shipment or easypost_get_shipment. API: POST /shipment

tools.name: easypost_refund_shipment
tools.description: Request a refund (void) of a purchased shipping label. WARNING: reverses a purchase; approval depends on the carrier and label age. API: POST /shipments/{id}/refund.
